545688.ov: HARJEETA, is based on the remarkable true story of Harjeet Singh, an Indian professional ﬁeld hockey player, who captained the Indian squad at the 2016 Men's Hockey Junior World Cup. His family, like so many families in this country was struggling with the biggest problem of our nation, poverty.

729112.ov: After serving his prison sentence, Gandhi returns to save his family as well as his village which is being plagued by criminals, drug dealers, caste-ism, poverty, and dirty politics.

1029784.ov: Rabba Hun Kee Kariye trails a shared history of Punjab -- a culture, language and a way of life- that was torn asunder in the fateful year of 1947. It captures feelings of guilt and remorse about the genocidal violence on the Indian side of Punjab.

1135128.ov: An NRI family returns to India to establish a charitable hospital- a long-lost desire of their elders, but their extended family creates issues.

1565080.ov: A young woman struggles to balances her life as a tailor with being a daughter to a bedridden mother.
